questions.question: Do you need my social media account password?

questions.question: Am I at risk of being banned or penalized?

questions.question: When will you deliver my order?

questions.answer: Don't worry, with our service you have a guarantee. Since these are real and active users, it's possible that someone will stop following you. In that case, we will ensure the reintegration of your account without problems.
